question: Under the inherited uniform size, uniform Prüfer tree and quarter-probability extra-opening law, what are the exact probabilities of ordinary parity closure, operator-admitting closure, and admission conditional on closure by cut four?
forbidden_inputs: No source selection by funding or outcome, no equal weighting of unlabelled shapes, no imputation of an omitted case, and no sign test on unsigned not-all-equal. Archive draws compare only after exact classification.
primary_observable: Exact integer mass and reduced rational probabilities for closure, odd-operator admission jointly with closure, and the conditional ratio per size and size-uniform mixture under four cuts, with both law trajectories.
cheapest_meaningful_control: A full labelled Prüfer census by tree type and number of extras, all decorated input renamings through n=5, physical ordinary versus witnessed-end funding, and signed-operator versus incidence classifier on every closure.
first_executable_signal: Classify four-holder representatives at both laws and compare every named small founder with its orbit weights and literal cut outcomes.
resource_budget: One CPU thread and six GiB address space per process, sizes four through eight and horizon four. Register any individual run projected over ten minutes before launch. Compare earlier observational caps separately from mathematical cutoff.
stop_rule: Verify all five labelled size masses, complete ordinary and unsigned histories and exact closure and admission probabilities, or isolate after independent attempt a specifically unverified decorated class and its unresolved probability mass.
decision_or_followup_rule: Separate sample comparison, proved relabelling and incidence results from finite exact counts. Report all stalled, closed, horizon-open and inapplicable cells, uncensored coverage and independent referee pending.
